Tables, Birthdays & Bulk Orders

Coming with a crew?

Ample indoor and outdoor seating means groups rarely wait — but a heads-up on WhatsApp gets your table, cake or tubs ready before you arrive.

Book a table

Birthday parties

Gelato cakes, flower cones for the whole table and a counter full of flavours to argue over. Tell the café the date and headcount — they'll help you plan the sweet part.

Catering & bulk tubs

For the Owner

Website audit — November 2026

  • No website existed for this outlet. The Hyderabad store's Google listing pointed its “website” button to an Instagram location page; the only brand site (milanoicecream.com) covers the original Kochi store.
  • Strong demand, no home: 4.1★ across 1,550+ Google reviews and 1,506 Justdial ratings — with nowhere to send that traffic for orders, bookings or the full menu.
  • This site fixes the gaps: the full recreated menu with photos, one-tap WhatsApp ordering and table booking, live open/closed status, directions, and party & bulk enquiries — all routing to the café's own number, +91 85208 27765.
  • Built from public sources: Google & Justdial listings, LBB Hyderabad, Siasat and Wanderlog. No prices were invented — only the listed ₹200–400 per-person range is shown.
